## The claim

The two independent rankers agree on at least 50% of the top 300 genes.

**Prediction if true.** The overlap between the local Resnik ranker's top 300 and Phen2Gene's top 300 on the same terms is >= 50%, read against Yuan 2022's measurement of how much two good rankers are expected to disagree.

**What would refute it.** Overlap < 50% — the ranking is method-dependent, and the target set is reported as one ranker's opinion rather than a converged nomination.

| 36 | refutes | 0.80 | measurement | Phen2Gene and the local Resnik ranker share 97 of their top 300 genes on the proband term set (32.3%); Monarch semsim returns only 50 genes, of which 13 are shared (26.0%). | `docs/iteration2/step-1/methodology/084-the-blind-target-set.md` |

## Weighing

```
prior 0.50  (log-odds +0.000)
  -1.600  refutes 0.80 — Phen2Gene and the local Resnik ranker share 97 of their top 300 genes on the proband term set (32.3%); Monarch semsim returns only 50 genes, of which 13 are shared (26.0%).   -> 0.168
suggested confidence 0.17 (0 supporting, 1 refuting, 0 neutral)
```

The weighing is a transparent heuristic for triage, not a calibrated posterior: the strengths are human judgments, and rows drawn from the same underlying data are not independent the way the sum treats them.
